const testCases = [
  {
    order: 1,
    id: "TC_QF_HEALTH_B",
    name: "Health B \u2014 Sin impacto tren inferior",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "QUALITY_FIX",
    whatsapp_id: 570000000061,
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM workouts WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000061')",
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000061')",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000061')",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000061'",
      "DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id LIKE '%570000000061%'"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "T-401",
        description: "No saltos/jumps/burpees para Health B",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000061' AND (e.spanish_name ILIKE '%salto%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%jump%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%burpee%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%box jump%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%sentadilla b\u00falgara%')",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 2,
    id: "TC_QF_HEALTH_C",
    name: "Health C \u2014 Sin overhead/press militar",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "QUALITY_FIX",
    whatsapp_id: 570000000062,
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM workouts WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000062')",
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000062')",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000062')",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000062'",
      "DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id LIKE '%570000000062%'"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "T-402",
        description: "No overhead/press militar para Health C",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000062' AND (e.spanish_name ILIKE '%press militar%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%overhead%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%snatch%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%press de hombro%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%push press%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%press arnold%')",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 3,
    id: "TC_QF_HEALTH_D",
    name: "Health D \u2014 Sin carga axial/deadlifts",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "QUALITY_FIX",
    whatsapp_id: 570000000063,
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM workouts WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000063')",
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000063')",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000063')",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000063'",
      "DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id LIKE '%570000000063%'"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "T-401b",
        description: "No deadlifts/lower back para Health D",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000063' AND (e.main_muscle = 'Lower back' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%peso muerto%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%deadlift%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%buenos d\u00edas%' OR e.spanish_name ILIKE '%good morning%')",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 4,
    id: "TC_QF_HEALTH_E",
    name: "Health E \u2014 Solo maquinas/cables (no barbell)",
    priority: "CRITICAL",
    category: "QUALITY_FIX",
    whatsapp_id: 570000000064,
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM workouts WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000064')",
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000064')",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000064')",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000064'",
      "DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id LIKE '%570000000064%'"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "T-401c",
        description: "No barbell equipment para Health E",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000064' AND e.equipment = 'barbell'",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 5,
    id: "TC_QF_STANDARD",
    name: "Standard 3-Day \u2014 Dedup, VolCap, Cardio, Pattern",
    priority: "HIGH",
    category: "QUALITY_FIX",
    whatsapp_id: 570000000065,
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM workouts WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000065')",
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000065')",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000065')",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000065'",
      "DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id LIKE '%570000000065%'"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "T-403",
        description: "No ejercicios duplicados por dia",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM (SELECT w.day_name, w.week, w.exercise_id FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000065' GROUP BY w.day_name, w.week, w.exercise_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) dups",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-404",
        description: "Volume cap: W2-W4 no excede W1",
        sql: "WITH ec AS (SELECT w.day_name, w.week, COUNT(DISTINCT w.exercise_id) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000065' GROUP BY w.day_name, w.week), w1 AS (SELECT day_name, cnt as w1_cnt FROM ec WHERE week = 1) SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ec JOIN w1 USING(day_name) WHERE ec.cnt > w1.w1_cnt",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-404b",
        description: "Deload: W4 sets no mayor a 3",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000065' AND w.week = 4 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(w.sets FROM '([0-9]+)$') AS INTEGER) > 3",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-405c",
        description: "Cardio no tiene params de isolation",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000065' AND e.role = 'cardio' AND w.tempo NOT IN ('--', 'N/A', 'continuous')",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-QF3",
        description: "No pattern mismatch (Abs en Push, Back en Push, Chest en Pull)",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000065' AND ((w.day_name ILIKE '%push%' AND e.main_muscle = 'Abs') OR (w.day_name ILIKE '%push%' AND e.main_muscle IN ('Back', 'Lats')) OR (w.day_name ILIKE '%pull%' AND e.main_muscle = 'Chest'))",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    order: 6,
    id: "TC_QF_5DAY",
    name: "5-Day Advanced \u2014 Validacion completa",
    priority: "HIGH",
    category: "QUALITY_FIX",
    whatsapp_id: 570000000066,
    cleanup: [
      "DELETE FROM workouts WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000066')",
      "DELETE FROM user_weekly_schedule WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000066')",
      "DELETE FROM users_plans WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000066')",
      "DELETE FROM users WHERE full_phone_number::text = '570000000066'",
      "DELETE FROM n8n_chat_histories WHERE session_id LIKE '%570000000066%'"
    ],
    validations: [
      {
        id: "T-406a",
        description: "No duplicados por dia (5-day)",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM (SELECT w.day_name, w.week, w.exercise_id FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000066' GROUP BY w.day_name, w.week, w.exercise_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) dups",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-406b",
        description: "Volume cap W2-W4 no excede W1 (5-day)",
        sql: "WITH ec AS (SELECT w.day_name, w.week, COUNT(DISTINCT w.exercise_id) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000066' GROUP BY w.day_name, w.week), w1 AS (SELECT day_name, cnt as w1_cnt FROM ec WHERE week = 1) SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ec JOIN w1 USING(day_name) WHERE ec.cnt > w1.w1_cnt",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-406c",
        description: "Deload W4 sets no mayor a 3 (5-day)",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000066' AND w.week = 4 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(w.sets FROM '([0-9]+)$') AS INTEGER) > 3",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-406e",
        description: "Cardio no tiene params de isolation (5-day)",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000066' AND e.role = 'cardio' AND w.tempo NOT IN ('--', 'N/A', 'continuous')",
        expected: 0,
        operator: "="
      },
      {
        id: "T-406f",
        description: "Tiene 5 dias distintos en W1",
        sql: "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.day_name) as cnt FROM workouts w JOIN users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.full_phone_number::text = '570000000066' AND w.week = 1",
        expected: 5,
        operator: "="
      }
    ]
  }
];

const sortedTests = testCases.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
$execution.customData.set('startTime', new Date().toISOString());
$execution.customData.set('totalTests', String(sortedTests.length));
$execution.customData.set('testResults', '[]');
console.log(`\u{1F4CB} QF Tests cargados: ${sortedTests.map(t => t.id).join(' -> ')}`);
return sortedTests.map(tc => ({ json: tc }));

parameters.query: ={{ $('Pre-Test Log').first().json.validations.map((v, i) => 'SELECT \'' + v.id + '\' as vid, cnt FROM (' + v.sql + ') _v' + i).join(' UNION ALL ') }}

## \u{1F9EA} WORKOUT_CREATOR Quality Fixes Test Runner

### Quality Fixes Validated:
- **QF-1**: W4 volume cap (W2-W4 \u2264 W1 exercise count)
- **QF-2**: Deduplication (no repeated exercise_id per day)
- **QF-3**: Pattern fixes (exercises correctly classified)
- **QF-4**: Cardio role (correct params: reps in seconds, tempo='--')
- **QF-5**: Health SQL enforcement (B/C/D/E restrictions)

### Prerequisites:
1. Run `e2e/quality_fixes_test_data.sql` in Supabase
2. Import WORKOUT_CREATOR.json in n8n
3. \u26A0\uFE0F Update workflow ID in "Execute WORKOUT_CREATOR" node

### Test Users:
| Phone | Health | Purpose |
|-------|--------|--------|
| 570000000061 | B | No saltos/impacto |
| 570000000062 | C | No overhead press |
| 570000000063 | D | No deadlifts |
| 570000000064 | E | No barbell |
| 570000000065 | A | Dedup, VolCap, Cardio |
| 570000000066 | A | 5-day full validation |
